_about: Known-good extension publishers. A match adds trust to an extension's risk score.
Chrome/Brave/Vivaldi/Opera/Chromium: trusted ONLY by chrome_publisher_ids (immutable Chrome Web
Store publisher ID, 'u' + 32 hex, from the publisher link on the listing page).
Firefox: trusted ONLY by amo_author_ids (immutable addons.mozilla.org user IDs, integers, from
Edge: the store exposes no publisher ID, so trust is per extension: edge_extension_ids (the
32-letter extension ID), and only while the Edge store lists that ID as public.
Display names are never trusted on those stores: anyone can register a lookalike.
Safari: only names listed in match_names are trusted (normalized: case, punctuation, legal
suffixes like Inc/LLC/Ltd/GmbH ignored). `name` alone is a label, never trusted. Leave
match_names empty for publishers verified only by store ID; avoid short/generic aliases.
Every entry needs name and added_at (ISO 8601 UTC). Invalid entries are skipped with a warning.
Edits apply on the next extension scoring cycle; no rebuild or restart needed.
